entities.summary: Francis Charles Granville Egerton, 3rd Earl of Ellesmere VD, DL, JP, styled Viscount Brackley between 1857 and 1862, was a British peer, soldier and author from the Egerton family. He owned several racehorses and 13,300 acres (54 km2) land.
